- `lanes/director.md`: a three-number line read by query at summary time is the right instrument for a reading nobody has, because it costs two listings the summary's author already makes and invents no label, state or row; posting the query with the numbers makes the definition auditable on the day it is read, which is what makes S1 a flag and not a defect. Defining non-fleet by `user.type`, the one field the listing serves, is the cheapest correct predicate; its blind spot (seat-operated human accounts) is a policy question for the seat, not a text error. - `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: taking the leg in `h67ReadOrder` is the right scope, since it is the only code that models 取卡全序 and the card says the code follows the text wherever the code reads author; reusing `artefactAuthor` keeps one author predicate in the file; reading an unreadable author as the fleet's is the conservative direction (a card is deferred, never promoted, on missing data); pinning the floor at the count makes the four cases load-bearing, and the controls above show each property reds on its own reversal.
